purpose: Investigate whether the X-HD Figure-5 County-ZCTA row has an available public County source or conversion rule close enough to justify execution beyond bounded Level-B fixtures.

sufficient: author-provided hashes for those WKT files
byte-identical deterministic regeneration from a documented author conversion pipeline
external review accepting a public-source regeneration as exact-equivalent
not_sufficient: current public services with different point counts

county_candidates.service_description_summary: 2020 U.S. Census County boundaries; sourced from U.S. Census Bureau 2020 TIGER FGDB National Sub-State and TIGER Hydrography to add detailed coastline for cartographic purposes; updated annually.

county_candidates.filter: STATEFP in 50 states plus District of Columbia

arcgis_usa_zip_code_areas_current_servic.service_description_summary: U.S. ZIP Code Boundaries; sourced from TomTom March 2023 and USPS/Esri Demographics; updated annually.

interpretation.primary_blocker: County source or conversion rule, not ZCTA and not RTDL execution.
why: The current ArcGIS County service has paper-like MBR but +32.2% more author-loader points than the paper log.
Direct TIGER2023 County has far fewer points than the paper log, even after filtering to 50 states plus DC.
The old RayJoin dtl_cnty CDB is a topology/CDB artifact with 17.3M points and is not X-HD WKT provenance.
ZCTA current public service is comparatively close to the paper count (+0.0711%), so running the pair before resolving County would not solve exact-input identity.
county_source_hypotheses_not_yet_proven: author used an older Esri/TIGER vintage between direct TIGER2023 and current ArcGIS detailed-coastline point counts
author used a specific ArcGIS export or simplification tolerance not captured by current service metadata
author used a WKT conversion/precision rule that drops or merges some current ArcGIS vertices
author used a preprocessed file from a private HDDatasets snapshot

allowed_next_actions: seek author dtl_cnty.wkt/uszipcode.wkt files or hashes
seek archived ArcGIS County export package or older Esri item that could produce about 9.44M loaded points
search for author conversion scripts or coordinate precision / simplification settings
keep County-ZCTA as bounded Level-B only until a source/conversion candidate matches the paper count
not_allowed: claim County-ZCTA exact paper input recovery
claim current ArcGIS County service is an exact author input
claim direct TIGER2023 County is an exact author input
claim old RayJoin CDB is X-HD WKT provenance
run a full-public County-ZCTA author/RTDL route as Figure-5 evidence before source/conversion identity changes
report an author-vs-RTDL performance ratio for this row
